caption: The drawing depicts a puppet-like figure dressed in a colorful floral-patterned dress and a white lace apron that covers the front of the dress. The figure has a large, exaggerated facial expression with prominent red cheeks, red lips, bushy black eyebrows, and blue eye accents. It wears a black, pointed hat with a decorative white lace trim, and a large white ruffled collar at the neck. A bright red, yellow, and green ribbon is tied in a bow at the throat. The hands are red, and the feet are covered by similarly patterned red footwear. The figure stands atop a textured brown object that appears to resemble a wooden block or stump. In the upper right part of the composition, there is a detailed side view of the puppet's head, showing the same facial features, ribbon, and lace details from another angle. The background of the drawing is an off-white or beige color, with no other objects or decorations.
title: Puppet: "Judy"
